english.notes:
(i) An "authorised person" means a person authorised by an appropriate authority.
(ii) Where an offence under these Regulations is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivance of an officer, or to be attributable to any neglect on the part of an officer, the officer as well as the body corporate, is guilty of an offence and is liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly.
(iii) "Officer" in relation to a body corporate means a director, manager, secretary or other similar officer of the body, or a person purporting to act in such capacity.
(iv) Where an offence under these Regulations is committed by a partnership or an unincorporated association bringing proceedings against the partnership or association in the name of the partnership or association, see regulation 47.
